name: Domain-Specific Evaluation Sets for LLM-as-a-judge
description: This benchmark introduces domain-specific evaluation sets tailored for LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, covering 14 categories with 1573 samples. It aims to improve separability and alignment with human preferences across diverse domains such as law, medicine, and multilingual contexts, providing an open-source evaluation tool for fine-grained analysis.
reputation: A recent benchmark proposal for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge systems; promising for research use but not yet broadly adopted as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on LLM evaluation as judges across diverse domains; improves separability and human agreement; open-source evaluation tool provided.
